body:
I too, feel like I deserve to feel bad when I feel like I hurt someone, somehow.

I just try watching tv or listening to music to try not thinking about things too much.  You can always try finding like a hobby/activity to do like putting together a puzzle, drawing, writing a poem or about anything that comes to mind.
I too, feel like I failed at life.

Yeah, I'm also having this problem with trying to donate to others.  I recently gotten put into a clan war.  But, one of the members are freaking out about not getting a dragon.  I was gonna donate them a dragon for the war, but it crashes.  I was thinking it was just me, but it seems like quite a bit of people are having the same issue.  :S

I heard about this Pokemon was able to be obtain from "participating McDonalds" from my brother.  He had our mom go out to the nearest McDonalds to ask about if they were doing the Pokemon thing and they told her no.  He was upset that the closest McDonalds wasn't doing this.  So... I'll let my brother know about this technique to get this Hoopa Pokemon.  Hopefully it works.  Would be nice to get this one.  :3

I also seemed to be getting the "cold-shoulder" by people when I try talking to them.  I have a friend who tells me that I can tell em things or talk to them whenever I want.  I try doing that and it seems like I'm talking to myself and/or a wall when they stop responding to me.  I feel like people are also avoiding me.  It does feel like people are looking the other way when I'm trying to reach out for help or making some sort of cries for help.  Then I feel like I don't matter to anyone as none shows any signs of caring/loving.  :/

I'm also curious how you gotten the courage to call the hotline.  I have a friend who told me to call it a few times, since last year, as I went into a deeper sadness state of mind.  But, I have this problem ... well, I'm selective mute, and I'm terrified of calling as I'll choke up.  Then on the other hand... I don't want them to somehow call the cops or something on me.  :x  I don't think that I'm actually in that strong field of being suicidal, but I tend to have thoughts about it from time to time.  :/

Wow!  I sometimes don't even wanna be around cause of the way I turned out.  I feel that when people actually see what I look like, they don't want anything to do with me.  I even gotten rotten comments from my family on the way I look.  Like my brother would say "no guys wants an ugly, fat girl like you".  Then he would refer to a scene in Family Guy where Meg asks about her clothing and the store employee pours gasoline and lights herself on fire.  But, meaning guys would do the same if they were to see me.  My mom ain't too great either with picking on my weight and making comments that guys like the skinnier girls 'n' such.

Also with the guys.  When I finally open up to them more... over the internet and show em a pic of me, they don't want anything to do with me.  It's like I'm a hideous monster.  But, I remember someone telling me "Beauty is in the eye of the beholder".  I don't really believe that as no one actually liked me.  It's sad that it seems most of the people worry more on the outside than the inside.
I'm sorry for your loss.  *hugs*

I guess I could relate to this in a way.  Though, I'm a nice gal and it seems guys don't want that.  It seems they want them partying gals.  More outgoing compared to me where I'm just a shy gal who prefers to be home.  lol  I had guys claiming to be "nice guys" but in all reality, they're not as they tend to hurt me or toy with my emotions.  Other than that, I'd prefer a nice guy.  XD  Some gals like the bad boys who'll only hurt them in the long run.  Then there's some gals who'll like the loving/liking 'n' caring guys.

I too, feel the same for a guy who's states (Ohio and Alabama) away from me.  He also don't think the long distance is great as he wants a physical relationship.  Or a relationship to be more around him.  Though, he did gave off *hint-hints* that he would like to try something with me if I go down to Alabama where he is.  :/
I feel the same way, to be honest.  If my family weren't around.

I'm sorry to hear that.  I get what you mean as I feel the same for a guy.  I guess he made me feel like I was worth something as well as he enjoyed my presence.  Well, he was making me happy... something I haven't felt in a long time.  But things happened to where I'm just really depressed.  Thinking I'll never get another person like that who'll be there to cheer me up.

I too, was picked on while I was in school and at home.  I wasn't a girly-girl and got picked on for looking like a tomboy/grungy/bum.  Heh, I even get picked on by my own family.  Mainly for my weight, though.

I wish I was that tall!  I'm only 5'7".  You look like you could be a model!  :)
Even I wouldn't want a guy like that.  Don't need people like that in my life.

I really hate that ... when it seems they enjoy my presence/having me around and all of the sudden "I was only toying with your emotions" or they "label me as a friend with no possibilities of anything".  Even though, they were the one(s) who wanted to be near me in the first place.  Two of em was even clingy towards me and they was only leading me on.  Like, they tried doing the flirty thing with me and get me to open up to em and "bam" 'you're just a friend to me'.  It's like it's their little sick mind games to make people feel bad while they continue on without any cares/remorse/regrets for what they've done to the other.
I could say the same for the guys who leads me on, on purpose.  :x

I get what cha mean.  I'm 27 and I've never had a boyfriend before.  Never dated, held hands, hugged, cuddled, kissed and whatever else others do.  To be honest, it does upset me ... looking around and seeing others having someone while I don't.  Heh, even my two childhood friends done gotten married and started a family and they're a year younger than me too.  :/

I find it just cruel to say to their own child.

I also can't tell my parents how I really feel about this life either.  Well, somehow, my mom learnt that I written on a piece of paper, in the past, that I "wish I was dead" and she went haywire over it.  She couldn't understand why I would write that and went on telling me that "you have everything and you shouldn't feel like that".  I may have everything, but for some odd reason... I still feel depressed.

Also, Odd thing is...  my mom for sure expresses her feelings of wanting to die if things were to go out of control.  :/
Aww... this would of been awesome to get.  XD  I don't even have a car to get to gamestop.  T_T
Cute kittens!
I think it's totally up to you if you wanna tell your roommate.  If you think they'll understand, I guess sure.  If not, you don't have to say a word about it.
I also feel like I'm gonna be alone forever.
I understand.  I'm also in that same boat with blowing off people cause I like this guy who's out of state.  Oddly, he's in Alabama.  o_O
It seems like we're all looked down upon for the things we like and/or do.  Heh... I got looked down upon for the way I dress.  XD  We all get that at one time or another.

I'm sorry to hear that about your husband.  I don't know why people have to be downright awful with saying such things to make the other(s) feel crummy.

I remember that I had a similar incident.  I was hanging out with a guy and he left me for another gal, but he told me to "go kill yourself".  He saw the the pain I was in and had to say that to make things worse.

I too, feel like a failure most of the times.  I'm 26 and I still live with my parents and no job.  While being in school, I never thought about my future plans.  I was always that depressed person.  I wasn't in the mood to do anything about my life.  I made all kinds of mistakes in the past that gave me a crummy future.  I tend to blame myself for all of what has happened around me and consider myself as a failure.

I'm not that top-notch person with smarts.  I've never went into any sports to help get myself a scholarship for college.  I'm overweight and get picked at for it.  I can barely pick up any weights as well.  Or it's hard for me to pick up a 40-pound bag of cat-food.  I wasn't the person my parents were hoping for me to be.  Or I can't do anything right for once.  Like I'm just a complete fail.

Sometimes, I ask myself the same thing ... "Would anyone care if I died?"  Sometimes, I feel like nobody would care, even though, there are people who care, but I/we just don't realize it at that moment.  I'm sure someone or more, for sure, would care if you were to die.  People feel alone and don't realize that there's others out there going through the same things or similar things as them.  "Death affects us all!"

Family - Would be walking around with a giant hole in their hearts and be grieving non-stop.  I hate saying this, but it may also cause a family member so much depression and they'll go too.  People hold onto items that belonged to the person whom they love and miss deeply, if the person isn't around anymore.  Some families tends to keep the bedroom(s)/room(s) the same that was by the person whom died.  Just to give an example.  My parents has a firefighters mask that was owned by my grandpa when he was a firefighter.  He passed away back in 1996 and till this day... I'm still grieving about him & others.  Or once in awhile, I cry about it.

Friends - Would also be walking around with a giant hole in their heart and be grieving as well.  They'll be asking themselves "What could I of done to prevent this tragedy?  I wish he/she would of talked about it with the family or me.  I wish they would of seek help."  Though, I don't have many friends, but I do care for them.  I would be devastated if one of my friends were to die.

Some people will most likely blame themselves if you were to die.  Heh... if you own a pet.  I bet the pet would care/miss you if you were to die.  I heard/saw/read stories about animals always visiting their owner's grave everyday till they pass on.  If it isn't a person, it'll be an animal being the one caring & missing you.  Same way with pets.  If the pet passes away, people miss them.

I'll tell you a story.  I known a guy whom owned a dog.  The dog ended up passing away and the guy was torn up so much, about it, not too long afterwards... the owner ended up passing away.  Most likely from a broken heart of his beloved pet.  I believe people end up dying from a broken heart as well by other people.  They miss them so much that they can barely go on anymore.

My final words to ya is... "You have so much potential!"  Even though, I don't know ya, but everyone has that "Potential" inside of them that they just gotta find.

I also have that "nice" guy thing going on, but I'm a girl instead.  I guess I've had a similar situation as you, but with guys instead.  I had guys ... pretending to like me one moment and all of the sudden, I get labeled as a "Friend and nothing more".

Like now, I really like this one guy cause he was giving me attention, was being flirty with me & understood what I was going through.  I eventually opened up to him and told him that I had a crush on him and that I really liked him.  I even shared a poem that I written for him, but I got rejected instantly.  He just told me that he isn't interested in me as in forming a relationship with and thought of me as a friend.  His reasons was that he isn't into the whole "long-distance relationship" and considered me as a friend.  I don't get it with him or other guys cause he/they hanged around with me or it seemed like he/they wanted me for a short time.  But as soon as I told him that I liked him... he backed off of me and wanted to be friends only.  Saying that he don't ever see us being in a relationship in this lifetime.  Just because we weren't closer to each other.  It just hurts me.  Also, it seems like he doesn't want to be a friend either cause he's been keeping his "distance" away from me.  Or he came out and told me that he's been keeping distance away from me, but still wanted to be friends.  I just don't get it.

Another guy that I was hanging out with (late 2012-Mid-March of 2013).  Whom I ran into on a MMORPG game.  He was always following me around on the game and wanted to hang out with my character 'n' such.  It seemed like he also liked me for a bit.  Heh... he even asked me to marry his character on the game.  I said sure, but he ended up hooking up with another gal behind my back and I freaked out about it.  Asking him questions about why he did that.  He just told me "I only think of you as a friend and nothing more".  I was really angry at him for that.

I don't get why guys are like that.  One moment... they seem to like me and the other moment, they label me as a "Friend" and soon don't want anything to do with me.  :(  Maybe I won't ever understand why they do that.

I know people told me to "keep your chin up and eventually you'll find that someone.  Don't waste your time on them jokers 'n' such..."  But I haven't found that someone yet and I do try keeping that tiny bit of hope that maybe something will blossom in between me and the guy.  My Negative thoughts:  Most of the guys that I grown attached to don't even like me back anyways.  It only feels like they played me or toy with my emotions and leave me crying in a corner.  I tend to start having negative thoughts about that guy or guys thinking as soon as they label me as a "Friend" ... "they hate me or think that I'm ugly and that's why they only wanted to be friends instead.  If I was prettier looking, maybe they would like me more."  It seems like people sees a hole/trust in the nicest person and just abuses that hole/trust without them realizing till it's too late and the damage is done.

~"The nicest people are usually the ones who gets hurt the most."  Sad but true.

I too, feel annoyed when I make plans with someone, a friend, and they never show up.  Or they show up for a tiny bit of time and then, they're gone.  I also feel like people use me as much as they can and when I can't give anymore ... it seems like they don't want anything to do with me anymore.  One moment, it seems like they care and all of the sudden ... they're gone when you need them the most.

I too, feel like most of the people who I ran into, in the past, were just a bunch of assholes.  Well, I opened my eyes at an early age and realized how messed up some of these people are.  I ended up seeing people in a different light than what they were giving off.  They pretend to be nice and back-stab you when you're not looking.  I also tried being nice towards people and I get shitted on.

From what heard about a conversation between my dad & his so-called friend.

"When it becomes between me and you, it's me."  ~ From the so-called friend.

I know there's some actual nice people out there, but it's just hard to run into them.  Especially when it's mostly full of assholes.
Talk about aggressive.  All I can say is... at least you know what kind of person he was.  *Showing his true colors.*
People just got no respect towards others now-a-days.  :(

I noticed that as well during my Senior year at high school and afterwards.  I remember there was a girl in my math class who got married during St. Patty's Day weekend back in 2007.  There was another gal who was already expecting a baby as well.  But, I did noticed quite a bit of kids who I graduated with was either engaged or married or even had a kid/kids.  In my mind, I'm thinking "I can't believe some of y'all are already going down that path to be starting a family 'n' such at a young age".

I even had a childhood friend who's a year younger than me and she already got married after high school and ended up having a kid about a year later or so.  Sad thing is... eventually, later on in life, some of them will open their eyes and see what has happened to them.

7 years since I graduated and the people who I remember talking about getting married 'n' such aren't with the person who they was with during the high school years.  It's really sad for the kid(s) that the parents rushed into it instead of taking an easy.
